Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The team is excited to move to a hands-on POC. We want to use the first session to validate prompt routing across our triage intents and run a short load rehearsal (100 concurrent users simulation).

- Can your team run through the prompt set we attached (prompt-set-olive-v2.csv) and confirm any changes needed?
- Propose 2x 2-hour slots next week (PST) for the hands-on lab + 30 min pre-call to wire up credentials.

Thanks,
Jen
Senior PM, Olive Health

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Feb 2028 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: POC lab recap — actions, timelines, and next session scheduling

Hi Jen / Kyle —

Thanks again for a productive session yesterday. Quick recap and owners pulled from the recording and runbook: 

Key outcomes:
- Prompt tuning: trimmed prompts reduced mean response tokens by ~8% and fixed two ambiguous intents (billing vs. scheduling).
- Routing: fallback policy now returns intent-level confidence + thin-cache hit for common prefixes.
- Load rehearsal: peak 110 concurrent simulated users, 20-minute steady at 100; tail p99 latency stayed within our target (520ms). No OOMs.

Action items (owners / due):
- Marissa: commit trimmed prompt set to the shared Drive and mark canonical test cases (due 2028-02-25) — Attachment: prompt-set-olive-v2-trimmed.csv
- Dev: rotate test API key to production-like TTL and add a short runbook step for key revocation post-POC (due 2028-02-24)
- Rishi: provide the exact GPU instance tags and cost estimate for a 2-week Dedicated pool (due 2028-02-28)
- Vanessa: write short postmortem with performance charts and link to session recording (due 2028-02-24) — Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1sessionrecap

Next session: Jen suggested a follow-up the week after to validate a second prompt family and run a longer soak (4 hours). Proposed windows:
- Tue 2028-02-28, 09:00–13:00 PST
- Thu 2028-03-02, 12:00–16:00 PST

Please reply with preferred window and any scope changes.

Thanks — great collaboration.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
